/recall/review.body: Skip to main content StudySquare MENU Home Practice LearnSpace Gap Maps Progress Classes Settings Welcome back, Sumba 1 Sumba Recall 1 / 30 CAMBRIDGE-IGCSE-BIOLOGY-MARRY-JONES-4TH-ED QUESTION Which characteristic is unique to living organisms and distinguishes them from non-living things? Tap card to reveal answer CAMBRIDGE-IGCSE-BIOLOGY-MARRY-JONES-4TH-ED ANSWER Ability to respond to stimuli This question tests the ability to differentiate between characteristics of living organisms. While growth, movement, and reproduction are common to many living organisms, the ability to respond to stimuli is a fundamental characteristic that distinguishes living organisms from non-living things. All living organisms can respond to their environment in some way. Reveal answer
